summary_en: JTM Holdings completed tender offer for RISE Inc. ordinary shares (48,966,800) and preferred shares (6,244,307), total 55,211,107. Minimum threshold exceeded; settlement begins 2026-06-19. JTM to become parent company and lead shareholder with >50% voting rights. Prior lead shareholder Yotei Holdings reduced to 72 shares post-settlement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Tender Offer for RISE Inc. Shares by JTM Holdings and Change of Parent Company and Lead Shareholder
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-12, JTM Holdings K.K. completed a tender offer for RISE Inc. ordinary and preferred shares that began 2026-05-18. The offer acquired 55,211,107 shares in aggregate (48,966,800 ordinary shares and 6,244,307 preferred shares), exceeding the minimum threshold of 55,211,079 shares. Settlement begins 2026-06-19. As a result of the tender offer, JTM Holdings will hold more than 50% of RISE's total voting rights as of the settlement date and will become the company's parent company and lead shareholder. The prior lead shareholder, Yotei Holdings LLC, had tendered all its RISE shares (55,211,079 in total) pursuant to a tender agreement dated 2026-05-15; however, because total tender applications exceeded the purchase target, shares were allocated pro rata among tendering shareholders. Yotei Holdings will retain only 72 shares post-settlement and will no longer qualify as a lead shareholder or parent company. JTM Holdings is a hotel, travel, and real-estate operator incorporated in 2016 with capital of 80 million yen, 100% owned by Sho Yamaze; it has no prior capital, personnel, or transaction relationship with RISE.
